title: Find more stories by the same reporter
context:
You will see a news story on the AP News website.
Imagine you liked this story and want to read more stories by the person who wrote it.
Your task: find the link that opens a list of their stories, and tap it.
prompt: Find the link that opens more stories by the reporter who wrote this story, and tap it.
label: AP News, the story about a spacecraft going to Mars
